item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 06/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be mild over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be misty with one or two rain patches over the region. Under the influence of a warm and humid maritime airstream, it will be foggy over the coast of Guangdong early next week. An intense northeast monsoon is expected to bring appreciably cooler weather to Guangdong midweek next week.
